name: Macro Pad
creator: Joshua Ferguson
desc: Touch buttons for key combos, BIOS/boot keys, and text on the KVM target.

NANOKVM_MCP_KEY.label: NanoKVM MCP API key
NANOKVM_MCP_KEY.description: Enable MCP in Settings, then paste the API key shown there.

DEFAULT_PROFILE.label: Default profile
DEFAULT_PROFILE.description: Windows, macOS, Linux, Mobile, Nav, or a custom profile name. The last used profile wins after first launch.

CUSTOM_MACROS.label: Custom macros (JSON)
CUSTOM_MACROS.description: Optional. A list of macros, or an object of named lists. See the App README for the format.
